about.title: About
about.lead: Find Your Fit brings Egypt's best local makers and the global houses you know into one considered place, then matches every piece to how you actually like to dress.

curated.title: Curated
curated.body: Every brand is chosen by people, for craft, fit and character.

personal.title: Personal
personal.body: A two-minute quiz builds your Style DNA, and every piece shows a Fit Match %.

local.title: Local first
local.body: Independent Egyptian labels sit right alongside international names.

honest.title: Honest
honest.body: You buy directly from the brand. We never mark up prices.

about.howBody1: When you swipe, we learn which cuts, colours, patterns, fabrics and levels of formality you gravitate towards. That becomes your Style DNA: a mix of style archetypes with a clear picture of what defines your taste.
about.howBody2: Each piece in the catalogue is described along the same dimensions, so we can show how closely it matches you. The more you swipe, save and shop, the sharper it gets. You can switch personalisation off at any time.
about.brandsBody: We list brands for free and send shoppers straight to your own store. If you'd like to be part of the edit, get in touch.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Find Your Fit helps you discover fashion matched to your taste. This policy explains what we collect, why, how long we keep it and the choices you have. We keep it short and plain on purpose.

sections.title: What we collect
bullets: Account details you give us: name, email, optional mobile number, date of birth, region, sizes and budget.
Your style answers: the looks you like, skip or dislike in the quiz, pieces you save and brands you follow.
Store visits: when you tap through to a brand's store, we record which piece and when, so the brand can be credited.
Searches: the words you search for, to improve results. These are stored without your name.
Anonymous usage counts, only if you allow analytics: for example how many people opened the app today. No identifiers are attached.

sections.title: Before you sign up
paragraphs: You can take the quiz without an account. We give your browser a random guest code so your answers can shape your Style DNA. If you create an account, those answers move to it; otherwise they are deleted after 30 days.

sections.title: How we use it
bullets: To build your Style DNA and show a Fit Match % on each piece.
To rank your feed and search results (you can turn personalisation off in your profile).
To keep your account secure and let you reset your password.
To send you new arrivals, only if you opt in.
To understand which brands and features are useful, using aggregate numbers.

sections.title: AI and automated matching
paragraphs: Matching is calculated by comparing the style dimensions of each piece with your answers. We use an AI model to describe products (for example, their cut or formality) and to understand search phrases. Your personal details are never sent to the AI model.

sections.title: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We don't sell your data. When you tap through to a brand, the brand sees a referral from Find Your Fit, not your identity. We use trusted service providers to run the app (hosting, our customer database and error monitoring), each bound to protect your data.

sections.title: How long we keep it
bullets: Account and profile: until you delete your account.
Style answers: up to 12 months, then they fade out of your DNA.
Guest quiz answers that never become an account: 30 days.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can view and edit your details, download all your data and delete your account at any time from your profile. For anything else, including objections or corrections, contact us and we'll respond within 30 days.

sections.title: Storage on your device
paragraphs: We store a sign-in token, a guest code, your consent choice and app preferences in your browser. We don't use advertising cookies or cross-site trackers.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Use the contact page and choose “Privacy or data request”.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms cover your use of Find Your Fit. By creating an account or using the app you agree to them.

sections.title: What we do
paragraphs: Find Your Fit is a discovery service. We show products from independent brands and retailers and link you to their stores. We are not the seller: purchases, payment, delivery, returns and refunds are between you and the brand, under the brand's own terms.

sections.title: Product information
paragraphs: Product details, prices and availability come from each brand's store and are refreshed regularly, but they can change. The price and stock shown on the brand's site at checkout are the ones that apply.

sections.title: Fit Match and Style DNA
paragraphs: Fit Match and Style DNA are suggestions based on your answers. They don't guarantee how a garment will fit your body. Always check the brand's size guide.

sections.title: Your account
bullets: You must be at least 16 to create an account.
Keep your password private. You're responsible for activity on your account.
Don't misuse the service: no scraping, automated access, or attempts to break security.

sections.title: Content and trademarks
paragraphs: Brand names, logos and product images belong to their owners and are shown to help you discover their products. The Find Your Fit name, logo and app design belong to us.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: We provide the service as is and work hard to keep it accurate and available. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for purchases made on third-party stores or for indirect losses.

sections.title: Changes and ending
paragraphs: We may update these terms and will tell you about significant changes in the app. You can stop using the service and delete your account at any time.

sections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt.
